canonical.title: A Weekend in Cassis Anchored on La Villa Madie

sources.title: La Villa Madie
sources.claim: La Villa Madie main site; Brasserie du Corton opened 2024 on same property

sources.title: La Villa Madie — Menus
sources.claim: Three tasting menus: €195 (4-course), €295 (6-course), €380 (8-course); menus change daily

sources.title: La Villa Madie — Reservations
sources.claim: Open Thu–Sun year-round; Mon opens 15 Jun–31 Aug only; lunch 12:00–13:00, dinner 19:30–20:45

sources.title: La Villa Madie — MICHELIN Guide
sources.claim: La Villa Madie: Three Stars restaurant in 2026 MICHELIN Guide France

sources.title: La Villa Madie review — GoLanguedoc
sources.claim: Panoramic sea views; sommelier holds 550+ vintages including local Cassis AOC whites

sources.title: Cassis AOC Vineyards — Office de Tourisme
sources.claim: ~215 ha, 10–12 domaines, 85% organic; one of France's 1936 original AOCs; crisp mineral white wine

sources.title: Calanques fire risk — Parc National
sources.claim: 1 Jun–30 Sep: massif graded daily; red days close all trails and Route des Crêtes; check Mes Calanques app

sources.title: Les Bateliers de Cassis — Boat Tours
sources.claim: Boat tours from port: 3 calanques 1h €21, 5 calanques 1h20 €25, 8 calanques 1h50 €29, 9 calanques 2h20 €33, swim-stop 2h €40

sources.title: Calanques access 2026 — Fréquence Sud
sources.claim: En-Vau and Cassis-side calanques (Port-Miou, Port-Pin) have NO mandatory reservation in 2026

sources.title: Route des Crêtes — Destination La Ciotat
sources.claim: D141 clifftop road, crests at La Grande Tête ~399 m, one of highest sea cliffs in France; allow 30 min–1h

sources.title: Route des Crêtes — Provence Lovers
sources.claim: Pedestrian-only every Sunday in season; closes on windy days sometimes without notice

sources.title: Getting to the Calanques from Cassis — Parc National
sources.claim: Park entrance 30 min on foot from town centre; Port-Pin 15 min further; En-Vau 30 min further; En-Vau climb steep

sources.title: Port-Pin to En-Vau trail — Calanques13
sources.claim: Port-Miou to Port-Pin: 2.3 km / 30 min / easy; to En-Vau: 3.8 km / 1h15 / medium; hands-on scramble into En-Vau

sources.title: Getting to Cassis — Office de Tourisme
sources.claim: Cassis SNCF station 3 km from centre; trains from Marseille ~every 30 min; bus 78 every 45 min

sources.title: Clos Sainte Magdeleine — Provence Tourisme
sources.claim: Guided tour + tasting Apr–Sep Mon–Sat 11am & 4pm, €10pp; postcard estate — terraced organic vines on sea cliffs

sources.title: Château de Fontcreuse
sources.claim: Tasting room in Cassis; 60% Marsanne white; made famous after Colonel Teed bought estate in 1922
